attributes.text: Coming up. If you already did it, press the big button.
Kamla, it's eight in the morning. Time for your Metformin, 500 mg. Take it with food, not on an empty stomach. When you have taken it, press the big button.
Say “I took it”, “I have eaten”, “one glass of water”, or “I'm not well” to call your people.
Today's plate: vegetables first, little salt, a small roti. Fruit if you want something sweet.
